cover_letter.greeting: Dear JPMorganChase Internal Audit Finance & Business Management Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Finance & Business Management Associate role in Internal Audit. I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and I worked as a consultant at JPMorgan Asset Management after roles at Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role's focus on executive-ready audit plan reporting, planning and operating rhythm for the Consumer & Community Banking Audit COO is close to the work I enjoy most, and I'd like to bring it back to the firm.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I turned large datasets into executive reporting and dashboards for senior leadership on budget allocation, and benchmarking past allocations identified 30% in efficiency gains. At Lenovo I owned the mapping and QA on AI-powered dashboards that saved 4+ hours a week of reporting. At Thomson Reuters I handled reconciliations at 85%+ accuracy and supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region.

That maps well to owning weekly and monthly plan reporting, keeping data quality checks and deadlines tight, and turning complex data into clear dashboards and presentations. I'm organized, careful with detail and comfortable working across teams on tight timelines. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the role.
